verdict.rationale: Connecting a domain to a host is a core question for a registrar, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no guided connect flow, DNS templates or one-click integrations for major hosts or platforms. The Terraform provider, Go SDK, API and Dynamic DNS are developer building blocks or adjacent DNS features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, connecting the domain to where my site lives is one guided step — templates or one-click connect for the major hosts and platforms
